content.text: Still scrolling the long table on my phone. It's a lot of rows. I'll check a bit more, then decide.

I'd go with an S&P 500 track, but I haven't actually picked one. I'm not very sure. What decided it: every company has one and the fees all look about the same, around 0.55%–0.7%. Altshuler Shaham's "עוקב מדד S&P 500" had the lowest fee I saw (0.54%) and it's a name I know, but it shows no return yet, only "פחות מ־3 שנים". Analyst's is 0.56% with 13.44% over 3 years, and that's the one I'd probably open, though not today.

**Where I looked:**
- **Top of the page:** The heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" fit what I came for, and "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" was already picked. 143 tracks from 12 companies is way too many. There was an S&P 500 filter button ("עוקב מדד s&p 500 12") that I'd have tapped, but I can't on screenshots.
- **The table:** I scrolled screens 2–10. I read the track name, the fee in "ההחיסכון" and the 3- and 5-year returns. "מניות" tracks show about 20–24% over 3 years, which looks best. The S&P 500 tracks are around 13% over 3 years and 11–12% over 5. Companies I passed: מור, אנליסט, מיטב, אלטשולר שחם, ילין לפידות.
- **I lost the first company's name.** It sits between screens 1 and 2, so I don't know who runs its S&P 500 track (0.56%, 13.7%).
- **I gave up after screen 10.** I skipped 11–14 and jumped to the bottom, which just ends. There's no "we recommend this".

**Skipped:** the orange notice at the top, the grey notes at the bottom, the little donut charts, the "נכסים" column and the "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link.

**Didn't get:**
- "חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח": "מט"ח" means nothing to me. The S&P tracks show 99%/99%, and some show "101%", which is odd.
- "דמי ניהול מההפקדות" vs "מההחיסכון": I don't know why there are two fees.
- "פחות מ־3 שנים" in the return column, "עוד לא דווח", the "123 מקור / מחושב / הזנתה" thing, and "גמיש".

**What bothered me:**
- It's one huge table, and nothing on it says which track is good for someone like me.
- The fees are all small percents. I have no idea what 0.54% vs 0.7% means in shekels on 30,000 ₪.
- The newest tracks have no fee and no return, just "עוד לא דווח".
- I'd have closed it around screen 9 or 10.
